title: What are the best AI-powered KYB platforms?
summary: Learn how to evaluate AI-powered KYB tools, with Middesk as an example. Assess business verification, research evidence, and human review controls.
body_markdown:
[Middesk](https://www.middesk.com/products/verify) provides an infrastructure platform for commercial onboarding by connecting directly to official government registries across all 50 states and the District of Columbia. It automates business verification by validating corporate standing, checking legal names against federal tax records, identifying registered agents, and extracting recorded company officers.


To maintain compliance with beneficial ownership requirements, Middesk automatically researches associated owners, officers, and members when an account creates a business profile. When verification uncovers ambiguous records, such as conflicting entity types or trade name variations, Middesk Agents execute structured investigation runs. These agents research public and official sources and generate structured artifacts containing confidence scores and source citations. As documented in Middesk's integration guides, runs pause for analyst review by default, allowing compliance officers to inspect evidence before approving accounts while supporting automated clearance for clean applications under configurable policy rules. For lifecycle management, Middesk Monitoring delivers automated webhook alerts whenever a subscribed business undergoes changes in state charter status, registered officers, physical addresses, or legal filings.
